steps.content:
<size=42>Let them think <color=#fb9259>justice</color> is on their side

Let them think they know <color=#fb9259>the truth</color></size>

<size=42><color=#fb9259>Fan</color> their <color=#fb9259>imaginations</color>

<color=#fb9259>Unbind</color> their <color=#fb9259>shackles</color></size>
<size=42>...And they shall <color=#fb9259>unleash</color> more <color=#fb9259>power</color> than you could ever imagine.</size>

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: ...Why hasn't that dumb bird come back yet?
Having waited for the raven for so long to no avail, Crache ushers the two into an abandoned building as a precaution.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Hella, are you still conscious? Where's Hecate?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Uh... I'm fine. It's just that... my head hurts.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hecate is in very bad shape. I put her to sleep, but she still looked really uncomfortable, like she's having a bad dream... Something's also wrong with her Nightmare, so I got her to put it away.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't know what'll happen when she wakes up.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: ...Tsk. Wait here. I'll be back soon.
Cloaked by shadows, Crache wanders through the crowd, keeping an ear out for anyone who might mention ${PlayerName} or the MBCC.
To her surprise, she immediately finds someone who does. Crache swiftly uses her shadows to bring a baseball bat-wielding rioter to a deserted alley.

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: Our fires will rage! We'll take back everything! Take back... huh?

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: What is this place?! Are you an enemy? An exec?! No, you're just a... little kid! You got a death wish?
As he tries to swing his bat at Crache's head, shadows wrap around his hands and feet and crawl up to his neck.

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: Ugh ahhhh! Spare me, please! I'm not a villain! I'm part of Ru-Rustfire, too!

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: You mentioned ${PlayerName}. What do you know about him? How is he?
steps.female_content: You mentioned ${PlayerName}. What do you know about her? How is she?

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: Ugh ahhhh, let go of me! I'm not a bad guy! I'm here to avenge him!
steps.female_content: Ugh ahhhh, let go of me! I'm not a bad guy! I'm here to avenge her!

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: Those vile execs from Eastside are the real enemies! We have to stay united! We have to avenge ${PlayerName}!

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: ...Avenge ${PlayerName}? What happened?

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: What I'm trying to say...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: What did you say?!

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: ...I'm back. Where's Hella?
Having expended too much energy, Hella finally falls asleep. Hecate is still awake, but she doesn't answer Crache's question.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Where's Chief? Did you get news about Chief?

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: ...Yeah. I know where he is now.
steps.female_content: ...Yeah. I know where she is now.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Where?! Tell me! I'm going there right now!

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: No!

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: ...The situation's a bit complicated. He got injured and is receiving treatment at a... clinic.
steps.female_content: ...The situation's a bit complicated. She got injured and is receiving treatment at a... clinic.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: You won't be able to find it. Plus, in your current condition, you'll just be a burden if you go.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...What did you say?
As soon as Nightmare appears, it gets shrouded and immobilized by shadows.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: What I mean is, you should stay here and hone your skills. Right now, you can't even escape these shadows.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: You can start protecting him again once I bring him back.
steps.female_content: You can start protecting her again once I bring her back.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Understood.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: You guys are sure the shackles are still around, right?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Of course! If the shackles had disappeared, that means Chief...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: All right, I'll go bring him back. You guys wait here. The Homeless will come pick you up in a bit.
steps.female_content: All right, I'll go bring her back. You guys wait here. The Homeless will come pick you up in a bit.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Before that happens, stay right here and don't go anywhere. Got it?

<size=42>They have<color=#fb9259> justice</color>

They have <color=#fb9259>the truth</color>

That's why they don't need to think about <color=#fb9259>right or wrong</color>

Or take responsibility for their <color=#fb9259>crimes</color></size>

<size=42><color=#fb9259>No matter</color> what they did

They did it with <color=#fb9259>countless others</color>

Hence, they must be in <color=#fb9259>the right</color></size>
